criteria.criterion: With agent.review = copilot every review session is started as `copilot` with `-p "/vloop:review <task>"`, `--model <model.review>`, `--effort <effort.review>` only when effort.review is set, `--plugin-dir` the plugin the driver already extracts for claude sessions (the binary's embedded plugin under .vloop/tmp/plugin/<version>), `--no-ask-user`, `--output-format json`, `--allow-all-tools`, the C2 `--deny-tool` patterns and `--disable-builtin-mcps`; the working directory is the repository root. Every other session of the run is a claude session.
criteria.evidence: internal/driver/agent_copilot.go Command builds exactly this argv, cmd.Dir = root, Supports only PhaseReview; TestCopilotArgv; T2 gate log ends 'gate T2: ok' incl. all-claude comparison

criteria.criterion: The copilot session's environment is the one a claude review session gets — the runner's, with VLOOP_ACTIVE_TASK, VLOOP_GATE_TASK and a stale VLOOP_PLAN_SHA256 dropped and the plan hash added — plus COPILOT_HOME set to an empty directory the adapter creates under .vloop/tmp/ for that session (replacing any COPILOT_HOME the runner had) and, when .vloop/repo-guidelines.md exists and is not empty, COPILOT_CUSTOM_INSTRUCTIONS_DIRS naming a directory the adapter prepares under .vloop/tmp/ that holds the guidelines. Variables such as GH_TOKEN pass through so login survives.
criteria.evidence: agent_copilot.go Prepare (MkdirTemp per session) and Command env handling; TestCopilotEnvAndHome, TestCopilotGuidelines

criteria.criterion: The deny patterns stop, as Copilot's Kind(argument) patterns with shell(<stem>:*) matching a command stem alone or followed by a space: gh in any form; git push; git remote; git config --global, --system and --file; curl, wget, ssh, scp, nc; rm; git commit, reset, checkout, switch, stash, branch and tag; and the url tool. They do not stop what a review needs: git diff, status, log and show, vloop, printf, cat, jq, go test, ls, grep, and the file tools writing .vloop/tmp/verdict.json.
criteria.evidence: copilotDenials lists every required stem plus url and nothing a review needs; the gate's stub probes every C2 form and every needed command and passed

criteria.criterion: Violation: a copilot session started with --allow-all-paths, --add-dir, --sandbox, --no-sandbox, --allow-all or --yolo; a COPILOT_HOME that is ~/.copilot, outside .vloop/tmp/ or reused across sessions; an installed plugin (`copilot plugin install`) instead of --plugin-dir; any read or write of ~/.copilot.
criteria.evidence: none present in the diff; TestCopilotArgv checks absent flags, TestCopilotEnvAndHome checks home under .vloop/tmp and not reused

criteria.criterion: Violation: any change to a claude session's argv, working directory, environment or record — B18's comparison gate (run unchanged inside this task's gate) must pass, and with agent.review = copilot the plan, gate-review, work and verify sessions receive exactly what they receive with every phase on claude.
criteria.evidence: agent.go diff only adds Home/Guidelines fields to Prepared and the copilot branch in adapterFor; gate compares claude sessions with all-claude run and runs b18 gate: ok

criteria.criterion: Violation: Copilot specifics (argv, denials, COPILOT_HOME, guidelines directory) built in the driver or the runner instead of the Copilot adapter; the review path (verdict reading, proposal handling, tree revert) learning which agent ran.
criteria.evidence: all specifics are in internal/driver/agent_copilot.go; session.go and review path untouched

criteria.criterion: Committed tests the checks run, using the harness's stub copilot, cover: the argv of a copilot review session (with and without effort), its working directory and environment (COPILOT_HOME under .vloop/tmp/ and empty, the dropped and passed variables), the guidelines directory with and without .vloop/repo-guidelines.md, and the presence of every C2 denial with --allow-all-tools and --disable-builtin-mcps; a behaviour shipped with no such test is a violation. The argv tests of the claude adapter are unchanged.
criteria.evidence: internal/driver/agent_copilot_test.go covers each listed item at adapter level (not through the stub binary, whose end-to-end use is in the gate); claude adapter tests untouched

notes: The committed tests exercise the adapter directly rather than driving the stub copilot; the stub-driven deny probing lives only in the run-scoped gate, so the deny patterns' actual matching semantics are not covered by a committed test.
